```bash
# 1️⃣ Go to the temporary directory

#    • `xargs wc -l` feeds those file names to `wc`, printing “<line_count> <filename>”
#
#    If some file names contain spaces, wrap everything in quotes:
find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -print0 | xargs -0 wc -l

# 4️⃣ Result looks like:
#      42 ./log.txt

```bash
find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf "%f\n" | sort | \
while IFS= read -r fname; do
    printf '%s %d\n' "$(basename "$fname")" $(wc -l <"$fname")
done
```

That prints the same `<line_count> <filename>` pairs but guarantees alphabetical ordering.
